decisions.reason: Defining the switched 5V rail as sensor power does not change the ESP32 sleep modes, wake sources, clock rates, or deep-sleep policy.
The sensor-power purpose of the switched 5V rail does not change the battery connector's NTC contact requirement.
The source decision does not alter battery overcharge, overdischarge, thermal sensing, or thermal protection requirements.
The switched rail's sensor-power purpose does not change the Power Board's TVS ESD protection requirement.
